subject: Target-A: pack.t runtime regressed ~90s (s316b) → ~156s (s321) — suspect cl/pcl-pack.lisp regeneration
description:
DONE s334 — and BOTH halves of the premise were wrong.

MEASURED (pack.t at --jobs 1, split by phase):
  transpile (pl2cl, Pl/ only): HEAD 78.5 s -> 7.0 s after the fix
  run (SBCL runtime + generated CL): 54.7 s, unchanged
  sweep wall: ~156 s -> 68.7 s (now under the 90 s default timeout)

The artifact was innocent: loading cl/pcl-pack.lisp costs 3.7 s (4.9 s for
runtime+pack vs 1.2 s for the runtime alone), once per process, lazily on the
first pack/unpack. s316b had ALREADY A/B'd old vs new artifact at 147 s vs
140 s (the new one faster) and said so in the session log.

REAL CAUSE — a compile-time regression, one line, in the window the task title
excluded (the ~90 s reading was s315d, not s316b):
  810df31 (s315d)  5.74 s | 1ac4718 (s316) 5.80 s | 797a1a9 (s316b, #125) 73.76 s
with BYTE-IDENTICAL emission (206428 bytes) at all three.
#125's de-gate added `next if $skip && $skip->($t)` to _rewrite_var_uses's loop
over every PPI::Token. $skip = _symbol_is_declarator + _ref_shadowed, and
_ref_shadowed climbs the parent chain and scans each parent's preceding
siblings: O(file) per call, so per-token = quadratic. The symbol loop three
lines above had always filtered (`eq $canon`) BEFORE asking.

FIX (CLAUDE.md 11): hand $skip DOWN to _fix_interp_token, which consults it only
after the fixer matched the name, + a class pre-filter (_interp_token_candidate)
so whitespace/operator/word tokens never reach _elem_within either. Heredoc arm
rewrites a copy of the body lines so the veto can still refuse.

VERIFIED: corpus-diff = emission identical to HEAD across all 111 files; gate
130 files / 4572 PASS; pack.t sweep 5636/89, sweep-diff 0 new / 0 fixed vs its
58 blessed keys; six other large corpus files unchanged within noise (pack.t was
the outlier — the cost needs a promoted lexical AND a big token count).
GUARD: Pl/t/parser2-02.t +5 rows, counting the predicate's CALLS (2 now, 610
per-token) plus the three s316 scoping verdicts re-asserted on the padded file.
SPUN OFF: #213 (nesting makes emission quadratic — 94% leading whitespace).
